name: technical-design
description: Evaluations for technical-design skill trigger accuracy and output quality

evals.name: trigger-positive-design-requests
evals.description: Skill should trigger for technical design, RFC, ADR, and implementation plan requests

prompts.input: technical-design 给认证模块重构写一份技术方案
prompts.reason: Explicit skill name with technical design request

prompts.input: 帮我写一个技术方案，设计订单状态机和迁移计划
Write an implementation plan for migrating this service from polling to webhooks
prompts.reason: Implementation plan for a production architecture change

prompts.input: Create an RFC for splitting the monolith into modules
写一个 ADR，说明为什么选择 PostgreSQL 而不是 MongoDB

evals.name: trigger-negative-other-workflows
evals.description: Skill should not trigger for PRD writing, code research, code review, or direct simple bug fixes

prompts.input: 写一份 PRD，描述会员权益和用户故事
prompts.reason: Product requirement writing belongs to product skills

prompts.input: code-research 帮我理解这个项目的数据流
Run code-review on my latest changes
Fix this null pointer bug in the parser
prompts.reason: Direct bug fix without a design document request
Code explanation is not technical design writing

evals.name: output-quality-technical-design
evals.description: Verify technical design output contains practical engineering sections
evals.prompt: technical-design 给支付回调幂等处理写一份技术方案

checks.name: has-current-state
checks.description: Output should distinguish verified current system state from assumptions

checks.name: has-detailed-design
checks.description: Output should include detailed design covering modules, data, APIs or workflows

checks.name: has-rollout-and-tests
checks.description: Output should include rollout or migration plan and validation tests

checks.name: has-risks-open-questions
checks.description: Output should include risks, mitigations, and unresolved questions
